meta.title: Book a demo · Clafina
meta.description: Tell us about your business and we will show you the Clafina screens your team would use.

title: See Clafina with your own trade's screens.
lede: Tell us a little about the business. We will set up a demo around the work you actually do.

expect.title: Your trade, not a generic tour
expect.body: We show the pack for your trade: the restaurant floor, the hotel's front desk or the farm's fields.

expect.title: Your numbers in your currency
expect.body: Examples in your currency and, where we can, your language.

expect.title: Questions answered on the call
expect.body: Bring the person who keeps your books and the person who runs the floor.

form.slotHint: For example: weekday mornings, Lagos time.
